original_test_intent: Deactivate exactly one payload owned by the isolated test run and prove it is no longer live without interrupting another user's console or management path.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review identifies standard App 0x06/0x49 only for a pre-recorded, owner-approved payload type and instance.
manual_activity: Owner verifies payload ownership and approves the exact type/instance, independent liveness probe and response to ambiguous transport state.
safety_requirements: Distinguish already inactive from transport failure
agent_execution_scope: Close only the isolated session and archive evidence
engineer_actions: Approve payload selection and ambiguity policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek safely refuses TBD but omits the identifiable deactivation operation and ownership requirements.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, issue one App 0x06/0x49 through a bounded runner using the exact run-owned payload type/instance, then verify non-liveness independently.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD and 10/5 timing remain preserved; no payload identifier is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind deactivation to the activation record produced by the same isolated run, then verify both command completion and external non-liveness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds ownership, command identity, oracle and ambiguity handling to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A completion response without independent non-liveness does not prove cleanup; a status read without deactivation does not exercise this function.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale or guessed identifier can terminate another user's SOL/console payload, while a timeout can hide whether cleanup actually occurred.

project_override_considerations: A vendor session API is equivalent only if it targets the same run-owned payload and supplies equivalent completion plus non-liveness evidence; it does not validate raw 0x49 behavior unless separately exercised.
expected_evidence: Verified target/control-session and run-owned payload identity
Proof other payloads and logs were untouched

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The deactivation purpose is identifiable. Owned fixture, fields, oracle and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines an ownership-bound cleanup transaction and prevents destructive instance guessing, third-party session disruption and false success after ambiguous transport failure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Deactivation changes shared BMC session state, so an instance number alone is unsafe evidence of ownership. The request must be cryptographically or procedurally tied to the activation record from this run, and a separate probe must confirm non-liveness because a lost response can occur after the mutation applied.
